bridgeRouteRisk.summary: KRWQ has one issuer-native liability route on Ethereum and five LayerZero V2 OFT representations. The Ethereum OFT Adapter 0xbdc82654f3574a113cdbd62f39cbe02e5b522d57 locks canonical KRWQ in escrow and releases it on verified inbound messages; Base, Polygon, Fraxtal, Codex, and Morph burn on outbound transfer and mint on verified inbound messages. Adapter and destination Safe owners can change peer/configuration and representation upgrade surfaces, while LayerZero Endpoint V2 validation and DVN/Executor governance remain external failure domains. At the reviewed observations, the Adapter held 777,136,188.987974 KRWQ versus 777,125,188.987974 KRWQ summed across the five spokes, an 11,000 KRWQ pooled-inventory surplus rather than five independent native liabilities.

routes.reviewNote: Ethereum is the reviewed canonical issuer-native liability deployment. Its TransparentUpgradeableProxy and owner-managed minter/custodian path are documented in Mint Authority; the OFT Adapter is a separate bridge route and is not treated as native issuance.

controls.label: KRWQ Ethereum OFT Adapter owner (3/5 Safe)

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: At Ethereum block 25770699, the OFT Adapter 0xbdc82654f3574a113cdbd62f39cbe02e5b522d57 returned token() = the canonical KRWQ and approvalRequired() = true; its KRWQ balance was 777,136,188.987974. It is the canonical-side escrow/lockbox for the five reviewed routes.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The Adapter returned LayerZero Endpoint V2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and is the peer at EID 30101 for each reviewed destination OFT. The owner Safe can administer the Adapter's peer/configuration path; reverse peer reads on every destination returned this Adapter.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Ethereum Safe owns the OFT Adapter and its upgrade/admin surface. LayerZero Endpoint V2 message validation, ULN/DVN configuration, and Executor governance remain external to the issuer Safe.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: At the reviewed observations, the Adapter held 777,136,188.987974 KRWQ while Base, Polygon, Fraxtal, Codex, and Morph totalSupply values summed to 777,125,188.987974 KRWQ. The 11,000 KRWQ surplus is recorded as pooled route inventory; destination mint/burn is not treated as independent native issuance.
